from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A judgment document from the collection."""
    document_index: int | None = Field(description="The document's position/ID in the collection")
    title: str | None = Field(description="The judgment document title as written in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The case type: criminal (刑事), civil (民事), administrative (行政)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or crime name as stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
